real: Rendered on the server with ffmpeg
notInLibrary: The master file and the archive stay in the export folder: download them from here.
exchangeNote: Media paths are the real files on the server, taken from the saved project.

libraryTitle: Your library: the exported video is here
history.title: Previous exports
history.empty: No video exported for this project yet.
delete.title: Delete this export?
delete.message: {file} is removed from the export folder. A copy saved in your library stays.
error.ffmpeg_unavailable: ffmpeg is missing on the server: the video cannot be rendered.
error.nothing_to_export: No shot has a video file to export yet.
error.export_running: An export of this project is already running.
error.export_quota: The export folder is full: delete older exports and try again.

error.store_failed: The export could not be saved.
toast.saveFirst: The project could not be saved: nothing was exported.
finish.title: Finishing
finish.excluded: Finishing applies to the web and social files only; the master and archive come out untouched.
finish.unavailable: This PotionUI has none of the finishing effects.
finish.noLut: No LUT is installed: an administrator adds .cube files to the luts model folder.
finish.noLook: You have no look yet: make one in the Image editor.

finish.ready: The finished film is in your library.
finish.downloadFailed: Could not download the finished film.
finish.rawKept: The plain export is still available.
finish.failure.busy: Eight media tool runs are already waiting in PotionUI, so the finishing could not start.
finish.failure.quota: Your storage is full, so the finishing could not be saved.
finish.failure.gone: The exported file is no longer in the library.
finish.failure.noLibrary: The export has no library item to finish.
finish.failure.lost: The page lost track of the finishing. It may still end in PotionUI: look for the finished film in your library.
